about: TVmaze is a TV show database and guide. This CLI uses its free public JSON API (api.tvmaze.com) to search shows and people, look up shows by external IDs, and fetch show details, episodes, seasons, cast, crew, alternate titles, images, characters, person credits, TV and streaming schedules, and recent show updates.

commands.summary: Fuzzy-search shows by name; returns scored matches with full show objects
Fuzzy-search people (actors, crew) by name
Return the single best-matching show for a name, optionally with embedded episodes, cast or other data
Find a show by external ID (IMDb, TheTVDB or TVRage). Pass exactly one ID.
Get a show's main details by TVmaze show ID, optionally with embedded cast or next/previous episode

params.name: id
params.description: TVmaze show ID (from search results or the /shows/{id}/slug URL)

commands.summary: List all episodes of a show in airing order, optionally including specials

params.name: specials
params.description: Set to 1 to include special episodes

commands.summary: Get one episode of a show by season and episode number
List a show's episodes that aired on a given date

params.name: date
params.description: Air date in ISO 8601 format, e.g. 2008-01-20

commands.summary: List a show's seasons with their season IDs, dates, episode counts and networks
List the episodes of a season by its TVmaze season ID (from list-show-seasons)

params.name: id
params.description: TVmaze season ID (not the season number)

commands.summary: List a show's main cast: each person with the character they play
List a show's crew (creators, producers and so on) with their crew type
List a show's alternate titles (AKAs) by country
List a show's images (posters, banners, backgrounds) with their URLs
Page through the full show index, ordered by show ID (up to 250 shows per page)

params.name: page
params.description: Zero-based page number. Each page covers a block of 250 show IDs.

commands.summary: Get an episode's details by episode ID, with its parent show embedded

params.name: id
params.description: TVmaze episode ID (from episode lists or the /episodes/{id}/slug URL)

commands.summary: List the guest cast of an episode: each person with the character they play
Get a person's details (birthday, country, gender, image) by person ID

params.name: id
params.description: TVmaze person ID (from search-people, cast lists or the /people/{id}/slug URL)

commands.summary: List the shows a person was main cast in, with show details embedded
List a person's crew credits (for example Creator or Executive Producer), with show details embedded
List the episodes a person guest-starred in, with episode details embedded
Get a character's details by character ID
List the episodes airing on broadcast/cable TV in a country on a date, with show details

params.name: date
params.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-10-18; defaults to today

commands.summary: List the episodes released on web/streaming channels on a date, optionally for one country

params.name: date
params.description: ISO date, e.g. 2026-10-18; defaults to today

params.name: country
params.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code. Omit to get global streaming releases.

commands.summary: Get the shows updated in a recent time window, as a map of show ID to last-updated Unix timestamp

params.name: since
params.description: Time window. Omit to get every show.
